senses.gloss: to be round; to roll; to circle.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 85b:4">Sabb. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>ועוֹגֵל בה חמשה</he> and inscribes in it a circle of five in diameter.

senses.gloss: to be rounded. Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵇ הוא נסלל ונע׳ the cut in the skin of an animal (whose heart has been taken out while alive) rebounds and becomes rounded.
to draw a circle. Part. מְעַגֵּל, v. חוֹנִי.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 1:8">Maasr. I, 8</cite> <he>המגורה משיְעַגֵּל</he> when the figs are stored in a bin, they are subject to tithes when he has pressed them.
<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 1:8">Ib.</cite> <he>היה דש … ומעגל וכ׳</he> if after treading figs in a vessel or pressing in a bin &c.
Macc. II, 1 היה מֹעגל במעגילה if he was levelling the roof with a roller, v. מַעֲגִילָה; Y. ib. II, beg. 31ᶜ (also מַעֲגִיל, Hif.).

senses.gloss: to roll on an oiled surface, to smooth a person’s skin.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 10:10">Tosef. Ter. X, 10</cite> <he>ומְעַגְּלוֹ על גביו</he> and oints it (the child) by rolling it on his own body; Y. Maas. Sh. II, 53ᶜ top <he>ומעגלו ע״ג מיעיו</he>.

senses.gloss: to round off, form a round body, v. infra.
to round off, form a round body. Ohol. VII, 4 עד שיַעֲגִילוּ ראש כפיקה; Tosef. ib. VIII, 8 שעִגְּלוּ וכ׳ (v. R. S. to Ohol. l. c.), v. פִּיקָא I.

units: <cite ref="Niddah 56a:9">Nidd. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>מה רוק שמִתְעַגֵּל ויוצא וכ׳</he> as the secretion in the mouth is formed in globules on being discharged &c.; <cite ref="Niddah 19b">ib. 19ᵇ</cite>

senses.gloss: to roll one’s self on an oiled surface, to smooth one’s skin. Tosef. Ter. l. c. על טבלה של שייש להִתְעַגֵּל עליה on a marble plate to anoint himself upon it. Ib. 11; Tosef. Sabb. III (IV), 17; a. e.
